## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint:errors`
- [ ] `npm run build:prod`
- [ ] `npm run validate:packs`

- [ ] Generated `dist` output and compiled packs are not included
- [ ] Formatting-only changes are separated from behavioral changes
